South Shore Apartments

Live on Lady Bird Lake

AMLI South Shore offers East Riverside apartments on Lady Bird Lake with an inviting neighborhood feel near local dining and waterfront trails. Our collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences are centered around your everyday comfort. Interiors incorporate elegant quartz countertops with waterfall edges, while spa-inspired bathrooms provide oversized soaking tubs to help you unwind at the end of the day.


Living directly on the water provides you immediate access to the Ann and Roy Butler Hike and Bike Trail. Running errands is a breeze with H-E-B nearby, and the onsite retail and food truck park add even more variety to your daily routine. Quick access to I-35 also puts the best of East and South Austin just a short drive away. Reaching major employers takes minimal effort, as the community is positioned only five minutes from Downtown Austin with convenient Cap Metro and UT shuttle stops nearby.


Working from home? Our community is fully equipped with a business center, coffee bar, and individual meeting pods for all your needs. During downtime, residents frequently visit the two courtyard swimming pools or bring their pets to the half-acre dog park. Getting outside is easy with direct lake access and on-site bike and kayak storage, plus you can enjoy patio dining right downstairs at 1618 Asian Fusion.

Floor Plans & Pricing

Sophisticated Design, Luxury Lifestyle

Whether you select a studio, one-, two-, or three-bedroom home at AMLI South Shore, you will find an inviting space that naturally supports your everyday lifestyle. Specific options, including townhomes directly on the water that offer unobstructed views of Downtown Austin and Lady Bird Lake. High nine-foot ceilings create an open atmosphere, while programmable Wi-Fi thermostats and smart keyless entry help effortlessly manage your environment.

AMENITIES & FEATURES

Lakeside Living at its Finest

AMLI South Shore’s amenity package provides everything you need. Working from home is easy with two comfortable coworking spaces, a business center, and free coffee. When you’re ready to unwind, you have your pick of two rooftop decks that offer front-row seats to the downtown skyline. Your pets will love it here too, thanks to the half-acre dog park and a convenient paw wash station.
